Use o botão Acessibilidade e idioma, no: Use the Accessibility and language button in the bottom corner of the screen to open these features. In Reading preferences, choose system, light or dark appearance; standard or enhanced contrast; text from 100% to 200%; standard or comfortable spacing; and system or reduced motion.
Na versão em português, abra Acessibilid: In the Portuguese version, open Accessibility and language and select Libras to load the official VLibras service. The features panel closes and the avatar appears over the content without reducing the page width. Automatic translation depends on your connection and the service's servers.
O avatar permanece sobre a página enquan: The avatar stays over the page as you browse. Use the tool's Close button to uncover the content without reloading the page. To activate a selected link or button, use Interagir in the tool.
Com o VLibras aberto, selecione o link o: With VLibras open, select the link or button and use Interagir in the tool panel to activate it.
Ajuste a apresentação do site. Suas esco: Adjust the site's appearance. Your choices are saved in this browser when cookies are available.
Preferências de leitura restauradas. O i: Reading preferences reset. Your language and filters were kept.
Materiais didáticos, alfabetização, form: Learning materials, literacy, continuing teacher development and educational support. Independent redesign proposal by Felipe Maia.
Recursos de leitura, navegação por tecla: Reading features, keyboard navigation, languages and automatic Brazilian Sign Language translation available on this site.
No cabeçalho, abra Preferências de leitu: In the header, open Reading preferences to choose system, light or dark appearance; standard or enhanced contrast; text from 100% to 200%; standard or comfortable spacing; and system or reduced motion.
Os ajustes são aplicados ao conteúdo HTM: These settings apply to HTML content. You can also use your browser or device's zoom and accessibility features.
Suas preferências de leitura são guardad: Your reading preferences are stored in a cookie on this site for up to one year. If storage is blocked, the controls still work during your visit. Resetting preferences changes only these settings, preserving your language, filters and form data.
Use Tab e Shift + Tab para percorrer lin: Use Tab and Shift + Tab to move through links and controls. The first link skips to the content. Menus, preferences and enlarged images open in dialogs; Escape closes the dialog and focus returns to its trigger. Use the arrow keys within option groups.
Links externos que abrem outra aba têm e: External links that open another tab provide that information to assistive technologies. PDFs open only when you request them.
Português, English e Español estão dispo: Português, English and Español are available in the language selector. Switching keeps the equivalent page and URL filters. Your explicit choice is saved; when you visit a URL in another language, that URL is respected and the selector offers to return to your saved preference.
As traduções do site foram preparadas co: The website translations were prepared with AI assistance and have not yet undergone specialist human review. Collection and book titles remain as published. Original PDFs, photographs containing text and commercial materials are in Portuguese; the translated interface does not represent a foreign-language edition of those materials.
Na versão em português, o controle Libra: In the Portuguese version, the Libras control in the header loads the official VLibras service on request. The service automatically translates text passages into Brazilian Sign Language. The avatar depends on your connection and the service's servers.
A tradução automática não substitui a in: Automatic translation does not replace human interpretation. No linguistic validation has been performed by a Deaf person or a Libras interpreter. In the English and Spanish versions, the Libras link opens the equivalent page in Portuguese.
Informações essenciais de coleções, indi: Essential information about collections, indicators, maps and testimonials also appears in HTML text. Testimonial summaries are identified as summaries, rather than transcripts. Original images can be enlarged for reference.
Os três vídeos locais são vinhetas sem á: The three local videos are silent vignettes, with text descriptions and downloadable VTT files. PDFs preserve the published files; their internal accessibility structure has not yet been fully audited.
Este projeto busca atender às WCAG 2.2 n: This project aims to meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA. Implemented features and technical checks do not constitute a conformance certification. Evaluation with people with disabilities, real screen readers and human translation review are still needed.
Entre em contato e informe a página, o d: Contact us with the page, device, browser and difficulty you encountered. The form prepares an email message and does not send it automatically.
Os títulos publicados e os documentos or: Published titles and original documents are in Portuguese.
